# The ANNY body model's kernels, by their Lean/Slang module names, each with
# the targets it is compiled for (both: cpp, the in-guest CPU path, and
# spirv, the GPU path over rd_compute). None shares group memory.
# Forward, in dispatch order:
anny_blend both
anny_csr_gemv3 both
anny_fk both
anny_lbs both
anny_vert_residual both
# Backward (anny_csr_gemv3 runs again, on the regressor's transpose):
anny_lbs_backward_bone both
anny_lbs_backward_bind both
anny_fk_backward both
anny_blend_backward both
anny_capsule_depth both
anny_fk_local both
anny_ground both
# SOMA-X per-frame posing (ANNY identity, correctives), in dispatch order;
# soma_jump runs once per pointer-jumping round, anny_lbs skins last:
soma_orient both
soma_jump both
soma_twist both
soma_expand both
soma_skin both
soma_corr_l1 both
soma_corr_l2 both
